card.name: First piece of a word after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical or drug word that begins a new item right after a section heading or numbered subsection, such as Interstitial, Colitis, Colorectal or Repaglinide.

modes.label: After section headings
modes.description: Opening piece of a condition or drug name placed right after a heading like WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS or CONTRAINDICATIONS.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS<< Inter>>stitial Lung Disease (ILD) and P

modes.label: After a list number
modes.description: Opening piece of a new item after a parenthesized section number.
modes.example: Allergy to soy or eggs (4.1)<< Def>>ective lipid metabolism (4.2)

modes.label: Other word openings
modes.description: Opening piece of a drug name or chemical name in a table or text.
modes.example: Dependent on dose of carbamazepine<< Lam>>otrigine Decrease by 7

card.writes: It slightly favors words about metabolism and physiology, and weakly suppresses unrelated tokens, so the effect is unclear.
